content:
Oreo passed away last night. Hit by a car on the same road as Cas. Kind strangers did some door knocking to find us and hung around while I gathered her up. Poor kitty. At least it was quick. She was a very loved cat and will be missed a lot. 
I think I'm keeping it together the worst of all. Good time for Kate to be on limotrogrine. And school holidays so the kids have nowhere to be. Man this sucks. 
Had a night of crazy dreams. The last one was me waking up and Oreo there somehow making a miraculous recovery. How cruel of you brain. How very cruel.
